title: Musica Viva
description: A concert poster with no words, after Josef Müller-Brockmann's Musica Viva sheets for the Tonhalle Zürich: arc segments of concentric rings whose radii step through a just-intoned scale. Drag around the centre to tune it. Each ring turns at its own interval, 3/2, 4/3, 5/4, so the composition slides out of phase; let go and every ring springs to the nearest consonance, where all the arcs land back on the grid in a new poster, each sounding its interval softly as it settles.
intent: Translate the Musica Viva / Tonhalle posters (https://socks-studio.com/2016/11/30/joseph-muller-brockmann-musica-viva-posters-for-the-zurich-tonhalle/): concentric arcs, flat colour on white, off-centre and cropped at the sheet edge, where the geometry is the music.
